en: Illustrated postcard showing the entrance to a fairground or exhibition hall decorated with garlands and flags. A large crowd of people in early 20th‑century clothing gathers in front of the building, with several ticket booths labeled "KASSE". Above the entrance is signage for the "Grazer Herbstmesse" (Graz Autumn Fair). At the bottom, in a wide border, the title "GRAZER HERBSTMESSE" is prominently printed.
